content: Vaginal and vulvar cancers can present with symptoms such as abnormal vaginal bleeding or unusual discharge. It is important to understand the symptoms, risk factors, and available treatment options for vaginal and vulvar cancers. Certain factors may increase the likelihood of developing vaginal or vulvar cancer. Recent statistics provide updated information on the number of cases and deaths associated with vaginal and vulvar cancers. Women from various parts of the country have shared their personal experiences as survivors of vaginal and vulvar cancers. Receiving the HPV vaccine can significantly reduce the risk of developing vaginal and vulvar cancers. The CDC provides a detailed fact sheet containing valuable information about vaginal and vulvar cancers for public awareness and education.
